reasons.text: Duplicate check found another claim (66997b46-6fb9-50a9-92c1-636e69e52dc5) sharing the same address, so the claim must be sent to a person for review before any remedy.
The label photo is legible and shows model MK04, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
Serial number BN2411C16624 starts with BN and is in the recalled range.
Date code 11/2024 is prior to July 2025, within the recalled range.
Retailer Amazon.com is on the list and the purchase date 2024-12-20 is inside the sale window; receipt not required.
No destruction photo is required for this remedy.
